records.text: A viewer using the name Honey Butter said her husband thought the photographed object was a glove used with denatured alcohol to scrub Kirk's body.

appearances.snippet: Honey Butter writes, my husband says it's definitely a glove that is used to denature alcohol to scrub Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s body. That's what my husband uses at work with his woodworking and his gloves look exactly like that when he is done.
